title: Gulf MCR
summary: A Middle Eastern cafe concept shaped around brand atmosphere, bilingual cues, responsive sections and purposeful motion.
challenge: Translate a real cafe's identity into a premium web experience without turning it into a generic restaurant template.
solution: Built an atmospheric editorial layout with Arabic-influenced visual cues, mobile navigation, media slots and restrained interaction.
outcome: A deployed demo used as part of the 100-Day Local Business Website Challenge and direct business outreach.

title: Tasteology
summary: An editorial cafe website with branded typography, food storytelling, gallery structure and scroll-driven interactions.
challenge: Create something visually memorable while still keeping menu, location and navigation usable on mobile.
solution: Used bold typography, an ingredient-driven visual system, controlled motion and clear section sequencing.
outcome: A live GitHub Pages build demonstrating brand interpretation, layout refinement and responsive debugging.

title: NEC Avengers
summary: A character-driven interaction experiment exploring themed motion systems, HUD ideas and custom JavaScript behaviors.
challenge: Give each character a distinct interaction identity without making the page unusable.
solution: Explored character-specific motion concepts, responsive layout rules and JavaScript-triggered visual states.
outcome: A personal learning codebase for animation timing, interaction states and browser behavior.
